items.title: McDonald's vows to improve food, customer experience in new growth strategy
items.summary: Fast-food chain McDonald's (MCD) announced the launch of its new "NEXT" initiative at its investor day, promising to provide better food and improve customer experiences at their locations. The 8:30 Hosts Julie Hyman, Jake Conley, and Pras Subramanian discuss what this investment may ultimately look like.

items.title: Domino’s Pizza Is Down 28% This Year. Is It Time to Sell or Load Up?
items.summary: Domino's Pizza has shed more ground this year than any peer or benchmark in its category, yet one close competitor moved in the opposite direction entirely, which makes the sell-or-hold question harder than the chart alone suggests.

items.title: Starbucks (SBUX) Is Back. Next Up: A $1 Billion Cafe Makeover
items.summary: On September 10, 2026, CNBC reported that Starbucks Corporation (NASDAQ:SBUX) CEO Brian Niccol declared “Starbucks is back” two years into his tenure and outlined the next phase of the company’s turnaround, centered on renovating thousands of cafes and further improving customer service. More than 1,000 stores have already been refreshed over the past nine months. […]

items.title: MCD vs. SBUX: Which Payout Will Still Be Growing in 20 Years?
items.summary: Both McDonald's and Starbucks trail the 10-year Treasury yield right now, so picking the wrong one doesn't just mean slower growth. It means betting a retirement portfolio on a payout that might not survive the next decade.
